## Start with the real workflow

A useful starter is more than a collection of pages. It should connect the first sign-in to a real account, protect that account’s resources, and make it clear when something needs attention.

That means treating loading, empty, unavailable, and error states as part of the product. A service without credentials is not ready, and a successful redirect is not proof of payment.
